newsitem.title: USA: News target IFE in talks with Disney -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: News target IFE in talks with Disney -WSJ.

text.p: International Family Entertainment, owner of the Family Channel that is being courted by News Corp Ltd, has had talks with another possible suitor, Walt Disney Co, the Wall Street Journal reported.

In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal quoted an unnamed source familiar with the situation as saying Disney recently held acquisition talks with IFE, which is controlled by Pat Robertson and his family.

Other sources recently said News Corp made an offer that is valued at more than US$1 billion. The Journal said Wall Street's view is that Robertson may be hoping talks with Disney can be used as leverage to get a better deal from News Corp.
